categories.main_business_segments: Viva Biotech operates primarily in three segments: drug discovery services focusing on structure-based drug discovery for pre-clinical innovative drug development; CDMO and commercialization services involving contract development and manufacturing of small molecule APIs and intermediates; and Viva BioInnovator, which makes strategic investments in biotechnology startup companies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced structure-based drug discovery (SBDD) technology integrated with artificial intelligence (AI) to empower drug discovery workflows. Key technologies include protein structure determination, Cryo-EM, recombinant protein expression systems, DNA-encoded libraries, and AI-driven computational chemistry platforms. Manufacturing methods include contract development and manufacturing of APIs with ongoing capacity expansion and optimization of chemistry, manufacturing, and controls (CMC) operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Viva Biotech serves biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies worldwide, including global top 10 pharmaceutical firms. Customers include multinational pharmaceutical companies, biotech startups, scholars, and non-profit research institutions. The company’s services support pre-clinical drug development and commercial drug production, with a client base spanning the USA, Europe, Mainland China, and other regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: While headquartered and operating primarily in Mainland China with facilities in Shanghai, Chengdu, Jiaxing, Suzhou, Ningbo, and Taizhou, Viva Biotech has a global customer base. Major revenue contributors are the USA, European Union, Mainland China, and other Asian countries. The company has expanded its global footprint with a branch in Boston, USA, and partnerships with synchrotron radiation centers in multiple countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Viva Biotech operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, providing integrated drug discovery services (CRO) and contract development and manufacturing services (CDMO) for small molecule APIs and intermediates, supporting clients from early-stage research through to commercial drug production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on enhancing its AI-enabled SBDD one-stop drug R&D platform, integrating biological and chemical operations, and deepening synergy between CRO and CDMO businesses. R&D priorities include new drug targets, novel mechanisms of action, new drug modalities, and advancing AI-driven drug discovery. Capacity expansion and optimization of manufacturing facilities support future commercialization projects.
categories.revenue_model: Viva Biotech generates revenue through fee-for-service contracts in drug discovery and CDMO services, sales of products (APIs and intermediates), and strategic investments in biotech startups. Revenue streams include full-time-equivalent services, service-for-equity arrangements, and milestone payments from investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a global leader in structure-based drug discovery with a strong AI-driven platform. It competes with large international pharmaceutical enterprises and specialized CRO/CMO institutions. Viva Biotech emphasizes its integrated service platform and technological leadership to maintain competitive advantages in a highly competitive pharmaceutical R&D service market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Viva Biotech reported revenue of approximately RMB1.99 billion with a net profit of RMB222 million, marking a significant turnaround from a net loss in 2023. The adjusted non-IFRS net profit increased by over 50% year-on-year. The company has over 2,000 employees and continues to invest in capacity expansion and technology development, indicating a growth trajectory supported by operational recovery and strategic investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Viva Biotech offers a unique integrated one-stop platform combining advanced structure-based drug discovery with AI-driven capabilities, enabling efficient and innovative drug R&D. Its global leadership in protein structure determination, comprehensive technology platforms, and synergy between CRO and CDMO services provide clients with accelerated drug development timelines and high-quality manufacturing, differentiating it from competitors.
